v336_failure_diagnosis_and_fix.root_cause: In v33.6 (`02_v336_prod_blind_temporal_published_tools.py:275-277`), `from sklearn.base import clone` imported conda's `scikit-learn==1.4.2` BEFORE `sys.path.insert(0, runtime_sklearn)` (`scikit-learn==1.3.1`). Unpickling `hemopi2_ml_clf.sav` (trained in sklearn 1.3.1) under sklearn 1.4.2 crashed at `predict_proba` with `AttributeError: 'DecisionTreeClassifier' object has no attribute 'monotonic_cst'`.
v336_failure_diagnosis_and_fix.v336_silent_drop_audit: v33.6 caught the non-zero helper exit code and printed stderr without persisting a failure record into the JSON receipt. v34 fixes the import ordering so native scikit-learn 1.3.1 loads cleanly, verifies zero missing feature columns, and raises on any subprocess failure.

methodological_caveats: Off-the-shelf pretrained HemoPI2 models (ML and ESM2-t6) were trained on HemoPI2's own hemolytic threshold definition, whereas Peptide OmniPanel was trained on our hemolysis_cls definition; the same-split retrained HemoPI2-ML models (RF/ET/LGBM/XGB on exact 1,190 HemoPI2 features) eliminate both label-definition and training-corpus discrepancies.

The zero-overlap novel filter (n=2,334) excludes exact canonical sequence matches to HemoPI2's published cross_val_dataset.csv and independent_dataset.csv; homologous near-neighbors from shared DBAASP/Hemolytik literature may still favor off-the-shelf pretrained HemoPI2.

Official HemoPI2 (hemopi2_classification.py:lenchk) truncates input sequences >40 aa to the first 40 residues; both official truncated (<=40 aa) and full-length untruncated evaluations are reported alongside <=40 aa vs >40 aa stratified sensitivity analyses.

published_platform_comparison.disclaimer: Architectural and capability ledger compiled from published papers and public repositories. No fabricated cross-platform benchmark scores are reported where identical splits or public pretrained inference weights are unavailable; same-split empirical benchmarks are reported separately for HemoPI2 v1.3, CycPeptMP, Multi_CycGT, and PLifePred.

input_modalities: Arbitrary SMILES (cyclic/macrocyclic, N-methylated, D-amino acids, disulfide, stapled, lipidated/PEGylated NCAAs)
HELM / name lookup with automatic sequence-to-SMILES canonicalization
Peptide_OmniPanel_v3_4.model_architecture: 4-Foundation-Model Multimodal Super-Ensemble (NCAA-RepDistill-v2 + PeptideCLM-2 + ChemBERTa-MTR + ESM-C 600M) + CPU Tanimoto-KRR/SVR/LGBM/ET + Domain-MTL / Deep branches with strictly nested OOF simplex stacking and zero-holdout-peeking promotion

endpoint_domains.antimicrobial_biofilm_mic_mbc: 22 pathogen-specific MIC / MBC / MBIC / MBEC / MFC / LC endpoints

Peptide_OmniPanel_v3_4.uncertainty_and_ad: Mondrian Tanimoto AD tiers + cluster-weighted split-conformal 80%/90% intervals + Platt probability calibration + 3-tier CI-aware evidence grading (20 quantitative / 26 rank_only / 1 exploratory_not_recommended)
Peptide_OmniPanel_v3_4.interpretability: Direct production-ensemble perturbation attribution across all 47 endpoints (residue Ala/Gly masking + RDKit-valid chemical substituent pruning) + fidelity-audited E-GAT on 8 endpoints
Peptide_OmniPanel_v3_4.design_and_decision_tools: PeptideOpt multi-objective Pareto analog generator (5 strategies) + Batch Screening with 4-pillar Peptide-MPO [0-100] + 57-product FDA/DailyMed clinical PK reference & approved-peptide percentile context
Peptide_OmniPanel_v3_4.public_web_server_and_api: Live web server + FastAPI REST API + open-source code

input_modalities: Peptide SMILES / molecular graph (supports modified and cyclic peptides where SMILES provided)
pepADMET.model_architecture: Graph neural network / molecular fingerprint ML predictors trained per ADMET property
pepADMET.n_endpoints: Focused multi-endpoint peptide ADMET panel (primarily membrane permeability such as PAMPA/Caco-2, lipophilicity/solubility, toxicity/hemolysis, and selected PK/stability properties; narrower than 47 endpoints and without 22 pathogen-specific antimicrobial/biofilm endpoints)

endpoint_domains.systemic_clinical_pk: Limited coverage (typically lacks full human clinical CL/Vd/F/Cmax/PPB regulatory panel)
endpoint_domains.antimicrobial_biofilm_mic_mbc: Not a primary antimicrobial MIC/MBC/biofilm suite

pepADMET.uncertainty_and_ad: Standard point predictions; lacks Mondrian cluster-weighted conformal intervals and CI-aware 3-tier evidence grading
pepADMET.interpretability: Substructure/attention visualization where supported; no production-ensemble perturbation across 47 endpoints
pepADMET.design_and_decision_tools: ADMET prediction focus; does not bundle FDA DailyMed regulatory PK percentile lookup + 5-strategy Pareto PeptideOpt + 4-pillar Peptide-MPO batch screening
pepADMET.public_web_server_and_api: Published web/tool platform; pretrained weights/endpoints not directly drop-in runnable on our frozen 47-endpoint cluster-split benchmark without re-implementation

input_modalities: Canonical and modified peptide sequence / SMILES representations (unified peptide foundation/representation framework)
PeptiVerse.model_architecture: Peptide foundation / multi-property deep learning framework covering therapeutic peptide property prediction and discovery
PeptiVerse.n_endpoints: Broad therapeutic peptide property & bioactivity benchmarks (permeability, toxicity/hemolysis, half-life/stability, antimicrobial/therapeutic activity)

endpoint_domains.permeability_lipophilicity: Included (macrocycle permeability benchmarks such as CycPeptMPDB)
endpoint_domains.systemic_clinical_pk: Half-life / stability emphasis; lacks dedicated human FDA/DailyMed clinical CL/Vd/PPB/F/Cmax PK panel with approved-peptide percentile context
endpoint_domains.antimicrobial_biofilm_mic_mbc: General antimicrobial activity rather than 22 quantitative pathogen-stratified MIC/MBC/biofilm regression endpoints

PeptiVerse.uncertainty_and_ad: Point-estimate benchmarking; lacks Mondrian Tanimoto AD-stratified conformal UQ and explicit failure-mode grading (`exploratory_not_recommended`)
PeptiVerse.interpretability: Representation/embedding analysis; lacks unified direct ensemble perturbation attribution across all 47 ADMET/PK/MIC endpoints
PeptiVerse.design_and_decision_tools: Property prediction & peptide representation learning; lacks integrated clinical PK evidence index + approved-peptide percentiles + interactive Pareto PeptideOpt web workbench
PeptiVerse.public_web_server_and_api: Published benchmark/codebase; separate task definitions and splits prevent zero-leakage off-the-shelf scoring on our frozen cluster-grouped holdouts without retraining
